title: Event-Causal RAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Long Video Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
abstract: Large vision-language models perform well on short- and medium-length video understanding but still struggle to maintain coherent event memory and recover long-range relationships in ultra-long videos. End-to-end methods are limited by visual-token growth and context length, while fixed-segment retrieval often fragments complete events and weakens state-transition modeling.We propose Event-Causal RAG (EC-RAG), a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework for ultra-long and streaming video reasoning. A dual visual-audio sentinel mechanism segments video streams into semantically complete events, represented as State-Event-State (SES) structures that organize observable pre-event states, central events, and post-event states as event-local causal transitions. These transitions are stored in dual vector-graph memory and temporally connected through entity-consistent trajectories. During question answering, bidirectional graph retrieval recovers relevant predecessor and successor events, and answers are generated using both structured memory and the corresponding video evidence.We further introduce ECV-1H, an hour-scale long-video QA benchmark dedicated to directed event-causal reasoning, with all source videos exceeding one hour. It covers over 150 hours of untrimmed video and contains 1,251 fully human-annotated QA pairs. EC-RAG improves overall accuracy by 4.96\%--11.67\% across three open-source video foundation models and achieves consistent gains across public datasets. On a single RTX 5090 GPU with 32 GB of memory, EC-RAG can continuously process videos while maintaining controlled streaming memory usage.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2605.06185v2 全文整理；本地 PDF 共 9 页，SHA-256 57c9f1d462448c8f940c99d16bea28802a083c8ecde67713c54667f3be752814，并视觉核验第 1、4、5、6、7 页。
analysis.ideaZh: EC-RAG 用 visual+audio sentinel 把超长视频切成完整事件，再以 State–Event–State、entity trajectories 和 vector+graph memory 做前驱/后继检索；作者报告三种 open video VLM 在 ECV-1H 上提升 4.96–11.67 points、context tokens 从 15,429 降到 361，但 counter-intuitive subset 下降且 event/SES 都依赖 VLM 抽取，适合略读其 event-memory 设计。
methodFlow: 视觉变化与 ASR sentinel 将 stream 切为语义完整事件
VLM 抽取 State–Event–State 与 entity mentions
entity alignment 构建 vector store 和 temporal/state graph
query 触发 vector anchors 与 predecessor/successor graph traversal
去重后的 structured memory 与 source clips 支持 LVLM answer
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它推进 long-video VLM 的事件记忆与时序/因果检索，对 streaming multimodal reasoning 和 agent memory 有直接迁移价值。
analysis.evidenceZh: EC-RAG 把 dual-sentinel event segmentation、SES memory、dual-store graph 和 bidirectional retrieval 组成闭环。（Methodology, Fig. 2, pp. 3–4）；作者报告 ECV-1H 上 InternVL3.5、VideoLLaMA3、Qwen3-VL overall 分别提升 4.96、11.67、6.95 points。（Table 1, p. 5）；作者报告相对 Video-RAG，平均 retrieved context 从 15,429 tokens 降至 361，但 Event-Bench counter-intuitive accuracy 对三 backbone 均下降。（Tables 2–3 and analysis, p. 6）；移除 graph topology+bidirectional traversal 的 text-only accuracy 从 49.37 降到 38.99；24-hour test 仍暴露 extraction validity 与部署成本边界。（Table 5 and Figs. 3–4, p. 7）
analysis.caveatZh: counter-intuitive questions 因 literal SES over-anchoring 出现 0.44–6.61 points 下降。；未来仍需扩展 ECV-1H，并加强 segmentation、memory 与 adaptive retrieval 的耦合。；event boundaries、SES 和 entity coreference 均由模型/threshold 产生，错误会被 graph 放大并形成看似结构化的伪因果。；ECV-1H 规模仅 1,251 QA，且由论文团队构建；24-hour stress test 证明稳定性但不等于开放域 reasoning accuracy。；没有 PDF 内公开 code URL；所有数字为作者报告，本项目未复现。
analysis.motivationZh: 框架用 SigLIP change minima 和 ASR sentence boundaries 形成 event clips，VLM 为每个事件抽取 entity-specific precondition/event/post-state，再通过 embedding coreference 建立跨事件轨迹。问答时先 vector recall，再沿 graph 做双向 predecessor/successor expansion、semantic deduplication，并把结构化 memory 与 source clips交给原 LVLM。论文同时发布 150+ hours、1,251 QA 的 ECV-1H，并做跨 backbone、公开 benchmark、消融、24-hour stress test 与 VRAM profiling。
analysis.methodZh: 相对 fixed-chunk video RAG，主要新意是 event-local SES transition、entity-consistent temporal graph 和双向因果检索；它是轻量外部记忆框架，不改变 backbone video VLM 本身。 方法流程：视觉变化与 ASR sentinel 将 stream 切为语义完整事件 → VLM 抽取 State–Event–State 与 entity mentions → entity alignment 构建 vector store 和 temporal/state graph → query 触发 vector anchors 与 predecessor/successor graph traversal → 去重后的 structured memory 与 source clips 支持 LVLM answer。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者在 123 个一小时以上视频构成的 ECV-1H（1,251 four-choice QA）上评测三种 7B/8B backbones，并在 NExT-QA、Event-Bench、Video-MME Long 做 transfer；另进行 text-only structural ablation、24-hour surveillance stress test 和 RTX 5090 VRAM profile。 作者报告 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 ECV-1H 从 53.88 提升到 60.83，Video-RAG 为 57.07。（Table 1, p. 5） 作者报告 EC-RAG 在 24-hour stream 中以约 2.14× real-time 处理，strict event validity 90.57%，VRAM 保持约 16.33–16.46 GiB。（Figs. 3–4, p. 7） Baseline coverage：与 direct inference、Video-RAG 及公开报告结果比较，并固定部分 frame budget；但 event extraction 本身调用 VLM，端到端计算成本与所有 baseline 的等价预算并未完全对齐。 Ablation：fixed chunks、SES、graph traversal、semantic deduplication 均有 text-only ablation；graph component 影响最大，但消融只在 Event-Bench Contextual 与 Qwen3-VL-8B 上进行。
analysis.insightZh: 收录并略读：event-centric memory 与 context compression 很有启发性，跨 backbone 和部署测试也较完整；但它仍是 VLM-extracted RAG wrapper，benchmark 规模、counter-intuitive regression 和端到端成本限制了优先级。 EC-RAG 用 visual+audio sentinel 把超长视频切成完整事件，再以 State–Event–State、entity trajectories 和 vector+graph memory 做前驱/后继检索；作者报告三种 open video VLM 在 ECV-1H 上提升 4.96–11.67 points、context tokens 从 15,429 降到 361，但 counter-intuitive subset 下降且 event/SES 都依赖 VLM 抽取，适合略读其 event-memory 设计。
